issues.where: crops E, F and H, sunlit walls and foreground rim of the large crater
issues.what: Fine surface relief on the crater walls smears into long, parallel ribbons, while the crater floor and some of the adjacent rock stay much sharper.
issues.fix: Restore slope-aware, multiscale rock detail on the walls and rim so fine relief retains its shape and stays consistent with the crater floor.

issues.where: crops B and F, sunlit upper globe around the dominant white ray crater
issues.what: Broad milky patches wash out the small craters, and several soft white spots look like glows painted over the sharper rocky surface.
issues.fix: Reduce the white bloom and integrate the bright ejecta into the surface texture, preserving small crater rims and grain through the bright patches.

issues.where: sky immediately outside the upper-left and top limb
issues.what: A narrow, continuous warm halo follows the bright edge of the otherwise sharply bounded rocky globe.
issues.fix: Keep the warm edge light on the surface and reduce the spill into space; if optical bloom is intended, tie it to the brightest parts of the limb.

issues.where: crops T and U, lower foreground plains between the small craters
issues.what: Scattered near-white pinpricks read as glitter against the soft, dark ground rather than as lit pieces of rock.
issues.fix: Reduce the isolated peaks and tie any remaining bright flecks to discernible, consistently lit rock facets.
